fixtures.name: sgd-batch1-baseline

passes.name: validation
passes.detail: Typed static DAG; supported operations and bounded shapes.

passes.name: dce
passes.detail: Keeps requested outputs, gradients, updates, and their dependencies.

passes.name: fold
passes.detail: 0 immutable expressions replaced with constants; bindings are never folded.

passes.name: cse
passes.detail: Exact operation, ordered inputs, attributes, shape and dtype; no algebraic rewrites.

passes.name: fusion
passes.detail: GPU only; same-shape single-consumer pointwise regions, bounded operations and bindings. Instrumentation disables fusion.

passes.name: schedule
passes.detail: Topological kernel order over the entire forward, backward, and update DAG.

passes.name: reuse
passes.detail: Scratch bytes; reuse only when previous last use is strictly before new dispatch. Persistent/input/output buffers stay separate.

fixtures.tolerance_notes: Float32 reductions, matmul accumulation and transcendental implementations may round differently; absolute tolerance protects near-zero values.
